name: core-ui
description: NUI shell for the core framework (Vue 3 + Vite, builds to ../html)

scripts.//build:dev: A shell that keeps Vue's own HMR runtime, for attaching a plugin dev server in game (DESIGN §38.11). The env var is what matters: `--mode development` alone does NOT give a dev Vue.
scripts.//test:unit: Globs, not directories: this Node runs a positional directory as a module instead of searching it. The .ts files run on Node's type stripping (DESIGN §38.15).
scripts.build:server: esbuild ../server/pg/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:pg-native --banner:js="// fxlint-disable-file: generated by 'npm run build:server' (core/ui) from server/pg/index.js - edit the source, not this file." --outfile=../server/db_pg.js --log-level=warning
